ecigs/asthma.t: E-cigarette use → Asthma (adult) · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
ecigs/asthma.d: Conflicting evidence on asthma at any age, in surveys of mostly adolescents and young adults (all cross-sectional), a related outcome outside the counts: odds ratio 1.36 (1.21–1.52), current e-cigarette users vs non-users.

ssri/peptic_ulcer.t: Antidepressant (SSRI) use → Peptic ulcer · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
ssri/peptic_ulcer.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk of upper gastrointestinal bleeding in NSAID users taking an SSRI, a related outcome outside the counts: odds ratio 1.75 (1.32–2.33), taking an SSRI alongside an anti-inflammatory painkiller vs the painkiller alone.

high_bmi/hypertension.t: High body-mass index → High blood pressure · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
high_bmi/hypertension.d: Strong evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 1.49 (1.40–1.60), per 5 kg/m2 higher body-mass index.

coffee/chd.t: Coffee consumption → Coronary heart disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
coffee/chd.d: Suggestive evidence of a lower risk: relative risk 0.90 (0.84–0.97), three to five cups of coffee a day vs none, new cases of coronary heart disease.

glucose_control/chd.t: Tight blood sugar control → Coronary heart disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
glucose_control/chd.d: Moderate evidence of a lower risk: hazard ratio 0.84 (0.75–0.94), intensive vs standard glucose lowering in type 2 diabetes, outcome non-fatal heart attack.

glucose_control/pad.t: Tight blood sugar control → Peripheral artery disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
glucose_control/pad.d: Weak evidence, with no clear effect: hazard ratio 0.91 (0.80–1.05), intensive vs standard glucose lowering in type 2 diabetes, outcome peripheral vascular disease.

racism_discrimination/t2d.t: Racism and discrimination → Type 2 diabetes · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
racism_discrimination/t2d.d: Weak evidence of a higher risk: hazard ratio 1.31 (1.20–1.42), highest quarter of everyday racism vs lowest quarter.

racism_discrimination/obesity.t: Racism and discrimination → Obesity · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
racism_discrimination/obesity.d: Weak evidence of a higher risk: rate ratio 1.69 (1.45–1.96), highest category of everyday racism at both surveys vs lowest category.

racism_discrimination/schizophrenia.t: Racism and discrimination → Schizophrenia · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
racism_discrimination/schizophrenia.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk of psychotic symptoms and experiences in surveys of ethnic minority groups, a related outcome outside the counts: odds ratio 1.77 (1.26–2.49), perceived ethnic discrimination reported vs not reported.

caregiving_burden/chd.t: Intensive unpaid caregiving → Coronary heart disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
caregiving_burden/chd.d: Conflicting evidence: relative risk 1.82 (1.08–3.05), caring for a disabled or ill spouse 9 or more hours a week vs no caregiving.

skipping_breakfast/obesity.t: Skipping breakfast → Obesity · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
skipping_breakfast/obesity.d: Conflicting evidence on overweight or obesity in cohort studies, a related outcome outside the counts: relative risk 1.44 (1.25–1.66), few breakfasts per week vs most days, pooled cohort studies.

job_insecurity/depression.t: Job insecurity and unemployment → Depression · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
job_insecurity/depression.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk of depressive symptoms on a questionnaire, a related outcome outside the counts: odds ratio 1.29 (1.06–1.57), perceived job insecurity vs secure employment.

added_sugar/masld.t: Added sugar in food → Fatty liver disease (MASLD) · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
added_sugar/masld.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.31 (1.17–1.48), regular consumption of foods with added fructose (biscuits, cakes, sweets, sugary drinks) vs low consumption.

high_bmi/erectile_dysfunction.t: High body-mass index → Erectile dysfunction · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
high_bmi/erectile_dysfunction.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.46 (1.24–1.72), obesity (BMI 30 or above) vs normal weight, adjusted for confounders.

smoking/psoriasis.t: Current cigarette smoking → Psoriasis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
smoking/psoriasis.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.78 (1.52–2.06), current smoker vs never smoker.

former_smoking/psoriasis.t: Former smoking → Psoriasis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
former_smoking/psoriasis.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.62 (1.33–1.99), former smoker vs never smoker.

long_hours/depression.t: Long working hours → Depression · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
long_hours/depression.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk of onset of depressive symptoms on a questionnaire, a related outcome outside the counts: relative risk 1.14 (1.03–1.25), 55 or more working hours a week vs standard hours.

eggs/t2d.t: Egg consumption → Type 2 diabetes · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
eggs/t2d.d: Conflicting evidence: hazard ratio 1.18 (1.13–1.24), each extra 3 eggs a week, United States cohorts.

insomnia/hypertension.t: Insomnia → High blood pressure · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
insomnia/hypertension.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 1.21 (1.10–1.33), insomnia vs no insomnia.

ecigs/chd.t: E-cigarette use → Coronary heart disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
ecigs/chd.d: Weak evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.33 (1.14–1.56), e-cigarette use vs no e-cigarette use, outcome myocardial infarction.

mht/vte.t: Menopausal hormone therapy → Venous thromboembolism · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
mht/vte.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.72 (1.47–2.01), oral menopausal hormone therapy vs no hormone therapy.

ocp/vte.t: Combined oral contraceptives → Venous thromboembolism · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
ocp/vte.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 3.50 (2.90–4.30), current use of a combined oral contraceptive vs no use.

smoking/glaucoma.t: Current cigarette smoking → Glaucoma · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
smoking/glaucoma.d: Weak evidence, with no clear effect: relative risk 0.97 (0.81–1.16), current smoker vs never smoker.

vitd_deficiency/multiple_sclerosis.t: Vitamin D deficiency → Multiple sclerosis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
vitd_deficiency/multiple_sclerosis.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 2.00 (1.70–2.50), each 1 standard deviation lower genetically predicted blood vitamin D level.

high_bmi/diverticular_disease.t: High body-mass index → Diverticular disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
high_bmi/diverticular_disease.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 1.28 (1.18–1.40), per 5 kg/m² higher body-mass index.

low_pa/diverticular_disease.t: Low physical activity → Diverticular disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
low_pa/diverticular_disease.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 1.32 (1.08–1.59), low physical activity vs high physical activity.

osa/hypertension.t: Obstructive sleep apnoea → High blood pressure · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
osa/hypertension.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.77 (1.30–2.41), high apnoea-hypopnoea index vs low apnoea-hypopnoea index.

high_bmi/aortic_stenosis.t: High body-mass index → Aortic valve stenosis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
high_bmi/aortic_stenosis.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: hazard ratio 1.09 (1.03–1.16), each 1 standard deviation higher genetically predicted body-mass index.

high_ldl/aortic_stenosis.t: High LDL cholesterol → Aortic valve stenosis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
high_ldl/aortic_stenosis.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk: hazard ratio 1.15 (1.08–1.21), each 1 standard deviation higher genetically predicted LDL cholesterol.

high_tg/aortic_stenosis.t: High triglycerides → Aortic valve stenosis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
high_tg/aortic_stenosis.d: Suggestive evidence, with no clear effect: hazard ratio 1.08 (1.00–1.16), each 1 standard deviation higher genetically predicted triglycerides.

insomnia/aortic_stenosis.t: Insomnia → Aortic valve stenosis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
insomnia/aortic_stenosis.d: Weak evidence of a higher risk: hazard ratio 1.32 (1.13–1.55), each one category higher genetically predicted insomnia.

antibiotics_exposure/ibd.t: Repeated antibiotic courses → Inflammatory bowel disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
antibiotics_exposure/ibd.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.66 (1.28–2.16), any antibiotic exposure vs none.

refined_grains/chd.t: Refined grains and white rice → Coronary heart disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
refined_grains/chd.d: Weak evidence, with no clear effect on cardiovascular disease, a related outcome outside the counts: hazard ratio 1.08 (0.99–1.18), high vs low refined grain intake.

nonsugar_sweeteners/chd.t: Non-sugar sweeteners → Coronary heart disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
nonsugar_sweeteners/chd.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 1.06 (1.02–1.11), per 250 mL a day of non-sugar-sweetened drinks.

nonsugar_sweeteners/hypertension.t: Non-sugar sweeteners → High blood pressure · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
nonsugar_sweeteners/hypertension.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 1.14 (1.09–1.18), high vs low intake of non-sugar-sweetened drinks.

screen_time/t2d.t: Recreational screen time → Type 2 diabetes · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
screen_time/t2d.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: relative risk 1.20 (1.14–1.27), per 2 hours a day of television viewing.

screen_time/chd.t: Recreational screen time → Coronary heart disease · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
screen_time/chd.d: Weak evidence of a higher risk of fatal or non-fatal cardiovascular disease, a related outcome outside the counts: relative risk 1.15 (1.06–1.23), per 2 hours a day of television viewing.

long_hours/afib.t: Long working hours → Atrial fibrillation · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
long_hours/afib.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: hazard ratio 1.42 (1.13–1.80), 55 or more working hours a week vs 35 to 40 hours.

dash_diet/heart_failure.t: DASH eating pattern → Heart failure · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
dash_diet/heart_failure.d: Moderate evidence of a lower risk: relative risk 0.71 (0.58–0.88), high vs low adherence to a DASH-style eating pattern.

dash_diet/stroke_isch.t: DASH eating pattern → Ischaemic stroke · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
dash_diet/stroke_isch.d: Moderate evidence of a lower risk of stroke of any type, a related outcome outside the counts: relative risk 0.81 (0.72–0.92), high vs low adherence to a DASH-style eating pattern.

depression_exposure/low_back_pain.t: Depression (as a risk factor) → Back pain · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
depression_exposure/low_back_pain.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.59 (1.26–2.01), depressive symptoms present vs absent, in people free of back pain at the start.

antibiotics_exposure/psoriasis.t: Repeated antibiotic courses → Psoriasis · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
antibiotics_exposure/psoriasis.d: Suggestive evidence of a higher risk: odds ratio 1.75 (1.44–2.11), antibiotic exposure in childhood vs none.

night_shift/obesity.t: Night shift work → Obesity · Chronic Disease Evidence Explorer
night_shift/obesity.d: Moderate evidence of a higher risk of obesity or overweight, cohort and cross-sectional studies pooled, a related outcome outside the counts: odds ratio 1.23 (1.17–1.29), night shift work vs day work.
